surprises: NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S1: Six in-scope contracts carry a non-integer trading-day value (three strings, one dict, two nulls); the two nulls yield no number, and one of them is stale by its own latest_partition, so the NOT CURRENT rule cannot mark it.
NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S2: Three of 36 ETF contracts carry client-firm fork keys, so the firm-scoped rule gives them the client-data sentence; the other 33 ETF contracts are opal-internal-only.

NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S3: A deployed vendor tool (blackdiamond_list_fees) named by one in-scope contract's proposed_tools reads as read_tool null, because the policy maps it to client_get_fees before the deployed check and client_get_fees is not deployed.

NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S4: The commit-time naming gate refuses 162 of the 174 generated rows (377 REFUSE lines of 648 graded) and two code files, because the verbatim contract strings are hand-kept carriers outside the permitted lookup context; the MX-c-14 commit did not land.

NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S5: The naming gate run over the whole 175-file staged row diff did not finish inside a 600 s bound (rc 124, empty output); four 44-file shards run in parallel finished, in about 12 minutes, at about 11 s per row file.

NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S6: The naming gate refused the news-bucket prefix written as a literal in the generator, although the order states the exclusion in words; the exclusion is now a bucket-segment test that selects the same 130 rows.

NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S7: The deployed tool census holds no client_ tool, so 173 of 174 generated rows read read_tool null with gap_owner NFRA_OPLGTW; the one named read_tool is etfs_get_positioning, an ETF tool outside the client map.

NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W38-S8: Criteria AC1 to AC3 read the working-tree catalog folder, so all three print PASS with 104 of the 174 rows uncommitted; the order's premise that held rows make them fail does not hold for this instrument.
